objective: Prevent unsupported or unverifiable producer-attestation rollout by enforcing the documented GitHub repository-visibility and account-plan boundary.
completed_slice: Added a fail-closed artifact-attestation eligibility preflight and six deterministic boundary tests. The target repository is private, so unknown account-plan status is blocked rather than inferred eligible.

verification.scope: isolated Node execution against exact contract logic

design_implication: Do not add actions/attest or claim producer authentication until private-repository eligibility is independently established. Keep cryptographic producer authentication as a separate layer from packet byte coherence and workflow/deployment outcome.
acceptance_remaining: Obtain authoritative account-plan evidence from GitHub billing or enterprise settings.
Rerun the preflight with a timestamped source locator.
If eligible, add a SHA-pinned attestation generation and verification path for the retained packet artifact.
Bind verified attestation subject digest and workflow identity into the existing packet coherence gate without expanding its claim ceiling.
Execute both authenticated exact-commit enumerators and retain their raw outputs.
claim_ceiling: Feature eligibility only. No attestation, producer identity, workflow result, deployment identity, runtime behavior, audibility, or human observation is proven.
safe_next_action: Verify the GitHub account plan through an authoritative settings surface. If Enterprise Cloud eligibility is confirmed, implement a SHA-pinned actions/attest step and gh attestation verify gate for the exact retained evidence packet; otherwise retain the blocked state and use digest/coherence evidence without calling it producer-authenticated.
